planets.name: TOI-4184 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-4184 with a 4.9-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-4184 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-4184. Its orbit and size follow Barkaoui et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
